description: A single savings goal in the list. Flat glass card with a status chip (icon+word+color), a status-colored progress bar, a sub-line (target + optional date), and an inline Update-Progress action. Mirrors bills-BillRow / debts-row proportions so the three list screens read identically.

targetDate.description: ISO date; omit sub fragment when empty

on_track.appliesTo: no deadline OR projected to hit target

behind.appliesTo: deadline exists and genuinely at risk (conservative)

rows: row1: name (bodyBold, colors.text, numberOfLines 1) | statusChip | amount (bodyBold, colors.text, flexShrink 0)
row2: progress bar (shared recipe, fill=barFill) + {percent}% (caption, colors.textMuted)
row3: sub 'of {target} · by {date}' (caption, colors.textMuted) | Update button

states: over-funded (bar caps 100%, amount shows true current)

accessibility.label: {name}, {funded | on track | behind}, {current} saved of {target}, {percent} percent{, due {date}}
accessibility.note: Status conveyed by chip icon + WORD + color and the bar color together — never color alone. Amount stays colors.text (neutral); status color lives on the chip + bar, matching bills/debts rows.

developerNotes: Drive chip, bar color, and amount off status = getGoalStatus(goal). 'Behind' is conservative — default to on_track when the pace check is ambiguous (never false-nag). Reuse existing openEdit / setProgressId handlers unchanged. Progress-bar width tweens with animation.medium on optimistic update; snap under reduce-motion.
